subject: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <s.lopez@fintechvault.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Fintech Vault is ready to move forward and we want to kick off our vendor onboarding. Two asks from our side to get the procurement checklist moving: a concise onboarding checklist (PO steps, invoices, SOC/attestation upload) and your standard DPA or DPA pointer. Specific questions our legal and security teams need answered up front:

- Do you require a signed DPA for customers processing regulated data? If yes, please attach your standard DPA or a link.
- Can you provide a current list of subprocessors and the regions they operate in?
- What are your default data retention windows for logs, telemetry, and customer content?
- Do you do any persistent storage of KV caches or model prompt logs that contain customer content?

If helpful, I can loop in our security and legal folks to a short kickoff call this week. Target timeline from procurement: PO issued within two weeks if there are no major contract issues.

Thanks — please attach any onboarding docs or links.

Monica Patel
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0148

Attachments: none in this initial message
From: Sara Lopez <s.lopez@fintechvault.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@fintechvault.com>, procurement@fintechvault.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions

Hi Monica —

Great to hear — happy to get this moving. I attached our onboarding packet and current subprocessor list. Quick answers below; the attachments have fuller detail.

- DPA: yes, we require a signed DPA for customers that send or store regulated customer content. I attached a copy of our standard DPA (FintechVault_DPA_v3.1.pdf) and a fillable onboarding questionnaire.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV of current subprocessors and the primary region/processor role. We use a mix of cloud providers and a third-party logging vendor.
- Retention: default retention windows are 90 days for application logs, 365 days for billing/transaction metadata, and 30 days for session/interaction telemetry unless a customer contract specifies otherwise.
- KV/Prompt logs: we persist encrypted prompt logs for 30 days to support debugging and quality regressions; KV caches are ephemeral and not persisted beyond session lifecycle unless explicitly exported by the customer.

I can join a 30-min call tomorrow at 10:00 PST if that works for your team.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Fintech Vault
s.lopez@fintechvault.com

Attachments:
- FintechVault_Onboarding_Packet.pdf
- FintechVault_DPA_v3.1.pdf
- FintechVault_Subprocessor_List.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <s.lopez@fintechvault.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions

Sara — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the attachments. A few clarifying items from legal/security before we schedule the call:

1) DPA scope: Priyom, can you confirm whether our standard amendments (data subject requests, breach notification SLA, and subprocessors clause) are compatible with the DPA_v3.1 language? If there are redlines we'll need to turn around them quickly.

2) Subprocessor details: Rachel, can you review the CSV and confirm any high-risk subprocessors (logging, analytics, or backup vendors that store PII). Sara — in the CSV can you add columns for (a) whether the subprocessor has a SOC2 report and (b) the most recent audit date?

3) Retention policy: Laura — finance needs a clear line for invoicing and billing archives; does the 365d billing retention map to exportable records for audits? Sara — can you confirm that billing/transaction metadata is exportable on request for audit purposes?

4) Export/erasure: For customer content removal, is there a documented deletion workflow? We need confirmation that upon contract termination or upon DSARs we can remove content and obtain confirmation.

If you can add the two extra columns to the subprocessor CSV and confirm deletion workflow, we'll be ready for the call. I'll tentatively accept the 10:00 PST slot tomorrow.

Thanks,
Monica

-----
Monica Patel
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@fintechvault.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <s.lopez@fintechvault.com>, procurement@fintechvault.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions

Monica / team —

Thanks for the questions. I've updated the subprocessor CSV to include SOC2 flag and last audit date; attached is the updated file (FintechVault_Subprocessor_List_v2.csv). Short answers inline:

- Deletion workflow: We maintain a documented deletion workflow — upon termination or DSAR, our Customer Data Operations team runs the deletion job and provides a signed confirmation letter within 10 business days. The process and sample confirmation letter are in the onboarding packet (see tab 4).
- Billing exports: billing/transaction metadata is exportable via our vendor portal; we can provide a one-time export for audit purposes in CSV/Parquet.
- DPA redlines: happy to review any specific legal edits. We prefer to limit retention and subprocessors changes to addenda rather than wholesale rework; we can also accept custom addenda for enterprise accounts.

Joining the 10:00 PST call. Link to vendor portal (for exports & onboarding uploads): https://vendors.fintechvault.com/onboard/PO-2026-045

Regards,
Tom Briggs
Head of Platform Ops
Fintech Vault

Attachment: FintechVault_Subprocessor_List_v2.csv
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Kickoff: vendor onboarding + DPA / subprocessor questions (internal)

Team —

Quick internal summary after reviewing attachments and Tom's note:

- DPA: FintechVault_DPA_v3.1 looks standard; main negotiable items will be (1) breach notification SLA (we should push for 72 hours), (2) subprocessors notice & approval cycle (we should ask for 10 business days minimum for high-risk subprocessors), and (3) deletion confirmation sample — confirm scope in the SOW.
- Subprocessors: Rachel to flag any high-risk vendors. If any third-party analytics vendors retain PII beyond 90 days we may require a narrow addendum.
- Next steps: schedule the 30-min kickoff with Fintech Vault tomorrow 10:00 PST (confirm dial-in), Laura to draft PO template and expected billing cadence, Vivek to prepare commercial summary (rates/discounts) and share before call. Priyom will prepare redline notes on the DPA for initial discussion.

I'll attach a short checklist to the call notes with action owners.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
